{{Quote|Heed the words of Jadek-To. You will not like them. I do not like them. The last Gormak must not die. There was no discussion. The interpretation was clear. If every Gormak dies, every Voss dies. This is true. Wage war but do not win. Survive. For total victory is death.|Writings of Jadek-To|<ref name="Imp March of Time" />}}
'''Jadek-To''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] living on [[Voss]] many years before his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society. He composed the [[Writings of Jadek-To]] that were etched on a pillar erected outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]].
